title: Great flower pot.
text: Great flower pot.. This is the flower pot I love!!! I always look for pots that have the drainage hole on the bottom of the pot. In my area, they are hard to find. You have to use stones in the other pots for drainage, but I like the air being able to circulate in the drainage to avoid root rot. This is the perfect pot. The sand color fits in with any decor for indoor plants. The size is nice. It has a shiny gloss coating. This came so well packed. The box was thick and inside another box. The pot itself was double wrapped in the foam padding and tiny bubbled bubble wrap. Love my new pot!

product_metadata.title: 1 Ceramic Pot (4", Desert Sand Color) with Pot Drainage Reservoir | Succulent Planters | Plant Pot | Flower Pots | Succulent Pots by Plants for Pets
features: PREMIUM CLAY PLANTERS: These clay crafted planting pots assist the grow process for live plants (repotting/transplanting purposes) or for seedlings working to develop into flourishing specimens. Durable clay composition makes plant containers suitable for both indoor and outdoor conditions.
SMART POT DESIGN: Small drainage holes funnel water flow into shallow saucer reservoirs, allowing for an easy and clean watering system. Fun, modern construction pots can be displayed anywhere.

MULTI-DECOR PURPOSES: Showcase house plants with ceramic pots in the living room or at the window, exhibit real cactus or succulent plants in pots outdoors, along the yard or garden. Presentable, simplistic pot is fitting for home decor.
SPECIES READINESS: Flower pots are capable of accommodating aloe vera plant, live cactus, peace lily, spider plant, aglaonema seeds, philodendron seeds, violet seeds, zz plant seeds and more.
ALL-AROUND CAPACITY: Each pot spans a 4 inch height, 4.5 inch mouth diameter, 2.5 inch bottom diameter and includes a color matching 4 inch saucer.
description: Growers may use pots for seeding or transplant (keep hose or pitcher nearby for watering). Fertilizer and potting soil are recommended accessories for promoting the growth process, however they are not necessary. Gardening strategies are unique to each individual's circumstances, methods of pots utilization will vary depending on species and conditions. Practical pot serves apartment decor, office decor, patio decor and general home decorations undertakings. Clay durability supports the use of pots for both indoors and outdoors. Stand pots (2. 5 inch base/bottom provides stability) atop dirt, wood, cement or alongside a decorative bowl. Bestow pots upon a fence, ledge, wall or trellis under sky access for natural light exposure. Incorporate a favorite glass, moss or fabric to enhance pot appearance through a creative, diy, zen activity. Combine with a mini barrel, rustic wagon, owl, tiki or fairy figurine - attain an outside-the-box, bespoke atmosphere by integrating household items in a clever fashion.
